metricDefinitions.aliasBands: First line harmonic above Nyquist, fitted jointly across pixel rows and vertical pan phases. Amplitude is expressed as a percentage of mean ink. Fit residuals and conditioning are retained. Analysis is skipped at or above 12 physical pixels per em.
metricDefinitions.rowContrast: RMS spatial contrast of row means. peakToPeakPercent is the phase range divided by mean contrast, multiplied by 100.
metricDefinitions.brightness: Mean ink in the interior crop, with the same phase modulation definition.
metricDefinitions.cpuMs: JavaScript submission time; p50 is median.
metricDefinitions.gpuMs: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 duration; not inferred from JavaScript time.
metricDefinitions.rafMs: Animation scheduling interval, not an isolated GPU cost or guaranteed application FPS.
metricDefinitions.phaseResourceDeltas: Cumulative counter differences over the 64 phase draws; instantaneous memory gauges and frame-local counters are omitted.
metricDefinitions.finalResources: Cumulative resource counters and final memory gauges at the end of each performance configuration; not measured-frame deltas.

fullApplicationSmoke.note: These application scheduling measurements are smoke-test evidence, not a before/after performance comparison.

limitations: The source-harmonic metric quantifies coherent line bands; it does not establish zero pixel variation for arbitrary content, every transform, browser, or GPU.
Warm tile reuse reduces glyph work. Preparing newly visible coverage can raise CPU submission and GPU p95 even when GPU mean and median improve.
The browser scheduled both comparison paths around 33 ms during this run; rAF results cannot establish a proportional application FPS improvement.
Minified text is deliberately band-limited. The preserved reading-size PNG establishes identical output for that reference view, not universal sharpness gains.
With optional float extensions disabled, alias suppression remained effective but direct compatibility rendering increased GPU mean, median, and p95 in the measured 10% DPR 1 workload.

memoryPressureSmoke.note: Resource differences are cumulative counter deltas; scratch allocation precedes phase measurement, so a zero scratch-byte delta does not mean no allocation.

compatibilitySmoke.note: This exercises direct prefiltered glyph rendering with the R8 compatibility mask. The float-tile performance improvement does not apply to this configuration.

contextRestorationSmoke.note: Browser harness forced context loss and restoration, then compared rendered pixels.
